meta.title: User Inactivation: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: User Inactivation controls and the role-based comparison between a non-Tenant Admin and a Tenant Admin, including signing in as both users and checking whether the action is refused or available
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: User Inactivation controls and the role-based comparison between a non-Tenant Admin and a Tenant Admin, including signing in as both users and checking whether the action is refused or available

args.need: sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant, attempt User Inactivation as each user, and record whether the action is refused or available

steps.note: No catalog step can access user administration, switch between these roles, or observe User Inactivation permissions.
Assert the resulting screen has no crash or server error after the tester performs the role comparison; this does not assert the permission behavior itself.
